issue_context.title: RichTextLabel ignores Line Separation custom constant
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

master (0cbb19a246)

### System information

macOS 11.4

### Issue description

Setting `RichTextLabel`'s  Line Separation custom constant does not change line spacing.

The custom constant works fine in 3.x.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a RichTextLabel and type in some text
2. Adjust the control's width so the text wraps (or just type in texts that have multiple lines)
3. In the Inspector, change "Custom Constants" -> "Line Separation"

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
